heading: Wednesday, September 23, 2026
topLine: Claude agents mine genomes and flag a previously undescribed reverse-transcriptase system.

items.headline: Claude agents mine genomes and flag a previously undescribed reverse-transcriptase system
items.summary: Anthropic reported that about 950 Claude agents spent 21 hours surveying over 200,000 reverse transcriptases across roughly 1.9 billion protein clusters, narrowing 3,500 candidate systems to 20 and identifying array-associated reverse transcriptases (ART), which pair a reverse transcriptase with an accessory gene and a CRISPR-like repeat array in phage DNA. Released as a company blog post and preprint, not peer reviewed: the system's biological function is unknown, wet-lab work is pending, and reporting notes that ten reruns of the same campaign failed to find the array.
